messages:
Nina Patel (CS): FYI Meridian renewal — they want to split the invoice 60/40 across two legal entities and shorten the term to 9 months. Procurement asked for PO to match the new entity. Need advice on pricing/prorate and signer authority. Tagging @Owen @Priya @Sam. Details: contract id M-2024-019.
Owen Li (AE): Thanks. Quick Q — do they want total spend same as annual prorate or do they expect discount for shorter term?
Nina Patel (CS): They expect same annualized price but only pay 9 months. So we need to calculate prorated invoice amounts. Also one entity is EU (VAT) — need tax handling.
Sam Torres (Finance): We can split invoice but need vendor codes for both entities and VAT ids. Also which billing entity receives support SLAs? That affects entitlements.
Priya Kapoor (Legal): Who will sign? If different legal entities sign, need two signature blocks or two SOWs. Also confirm PO references: 'Meridian SOW M-2024-019' on both POs.
Nina Patel (CS): Customer says entity A (Meridian Ltd, UK VAT: GB999999) covers seat license 60%. Entity B (Meridian US, EIN: 12-3456789) covers 40%. They want one combined e-sign but two invoices. Risk?
Priya Kapoor (Legal): One combined e-sign acceptable only if signatory has authority to bind both entities. Prefer separate docs to be safe. If they insist on combined e-sign we need an explicit showing of authority (board resolution or delegated signatory).
Owen Li (AE): Customer is pushing for e-sign to close this week. Can we do a split invoice + single e-sign shortcut: add clause 'Entity A and Entity B agree to be jointly and severally liable'?
Sam Torres (Finance): Joint and several liability risky for us. If UK + US entities, tax and vendor code would still be separate. We can issue two invoices referencing the same signed SOW. Finance prefers two signatures or PO on both invoices.
BillingBot: Reminder — to create split invoices use command: /invoice create --contract M-2024-019 --split '60:40' --entities 'Meridian Ltd|Meridian US' --notes 'PO required'
Nina Patel (CS): Copying customer (via thread) asking for PO numbers and signatory names. @Priya can you draft minimal amendment language for dual-entity signoff and shared SLA?
Priya Kapoor (Legal): I'll draft an amendment template. Quick draft snippet:

```text
Amendment: The Parties acknowledge that services will be invoiced to and payable by Entity A and Entity B per attached schedule. Each Entity shall be responsible for its portion; if a single document is signed, the signer represents they have authority to bind both.
```

I'll post doc in Google Drive shortly.
Owen Li (AE): Sounds good. I'll get customer PO numbers by EOD. @Sam once I have POs can finance confirm invoice routing?
Sam Torres (Finance): Yes. Send PO + VAT/EIN and desired invoice recipients (email). We will queue split invoices and mark them as 'payable to' accordingly. Expect processing 1 business day after docs.
Nina Patel (CS): Great — action items:
- Owen: collect POs + signatory names (EOD)
- Priya: amendment draft (TOM)
- Sam: prepare invoice template once POs received
- BillingBot: await /invoice create command

If we can e-sign today, good. If not, we proceed with two SOW signatures. :thumbsup:
